claim: Additional calls help only when they add unique discriminative relation information that survives to the comparator.
status: challenged by E10: clinical gains are predominantly rank-conversion-mediated despite near-zero D3 candidate novelty; relation novelty remains unmeasured
falsifier: Extra calls improve accuracy without unique-candidate or relation-fidelity mediation; E10 now satisfies the candidate-novelty half, while RCR3 must test relation fidelity.

claim: Substring identity merging causes clinically invalid sibling/parent/component evidence transfer.
falsifier: Typed registry does not reduce identity loss or improves no strict endpoint under fixed raw views.

claim: A compact exposure set has a conversion sweet spot around four to six independent concepts.
falsifier: Conversion is monotone or invariant after candidate quality and pool are fixed.

claim: Time/scope-insensitive absolute vetoes actively reject recoverable correct diagnoses, but a soft-veto prompt is not thereby a proven superior ranker.
falsifier: Blinded manual review validates the hard reference vetoes, or fixed-pool soft veto creates at least equal reference-veto harm without rescues.

claim: Forest benefit is not attributable to generator content alone.
falsifier: All selectors are exchangeable on fixed canonical pools and evidence tables.

claim: B06 sequential history sharply suppresses candidate diversity and acts as consensus compression; its current-sample rank-conversion gains coexist with rare-candidate erasure, while closed-pool Supervisor is not the primary diversity bottleneck.
falsifier: A blinded paired replication finds no history effect on union/Jaccard/novelty, or shows that aggregation—not generation history—creates the observed loss of minority candidates.

claim: B07 refine is dead computation and retrieval benefit is not yet identified.
falsifier: Refine has positive paired net effect or relevant retrieval fails to beat off/random controls.

claim: e7 errors are jointly mediated by representation loss, shortlist width and comparator behavior.
falsifier: None of the controlled factors changes strict conversion on fixed S2 proposals.

claim: RCR-3 improves relation fidelity and strict conversion at three calls without mapper-dependent gains.
falsifier: No strict gain, task harm, or stage mediation inconsistent with relation/identity/contrast mechanisms.

claim: A time ledger changes selector behavior, but legal ledger row order produces comparable champion instability and neither perturbation has demonstrated net accuracy direction.
falsifier: Invalid time changes no champions, or time perturbations produce directionally consistent accuracy changes beyond legal-order sensitivity.

claim: Negative-event structuring can itself manufacture false vetoes through polarity, subject-scope and missing-test errors.
falsifier: Span-grounded manual audit finds no meaning-changing extraction error or no downstream veto attributable to one.
